Sr. Pre-qualification Criteria Technical Prequalification criteria- The bidder shall have in the last seven years, manufactured and supplied to reputed Fertilizer/ Refinery/ Oil and gas /Power plant, at least one straight tube OR U tube, shell and tube heat exch anger under TPI inspection of M/s LRA/TUV/BV/PDIL/ DNV/IBR/SGS/ BAX Counsel, fulfilling all the fo llowing conditions. 1) Exchanger/ tube bundle shall have minimum 906 Nos U tubes/ 1812 Nos straight tubes in MOC ASTM A213 TP 304 or any other grade of austenitic stainless steel or higher grade stainless steel. 2) The exchanger shall be hydro tested at a minimum pressure of 30 kg/cm2. 1 Vendor shall submit the following documents in support of the above supply. 1) Self attested copy of purchase order and drawing clearly showing ty pe of construction, OD, length, MOC and number of tubes and hydro test pressure. 2) Self attested copy of certificate of Hydro test witnessed by client/TPI agency. 3) Self attested copy of TPI release note. Conditions at point No 1 i.e. for No of tubes and MOC and point no 2 i.e. for hydro test above, shall be fulfilled in either a single purchase order or maximum two separate purchase orders i.e. one fo r No of tubes and MOC and other. for hydro test.
